call_purpose: Your custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, although your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record for your main address using the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings, and your funnel now loads there.
Following our guidance, you also replaced the second record for the www version with a CNAME using the same target value, and you confirmed both addresses now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that an old A record was blocking the connection, which is why it had to be replaced with a CNAME record.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that your secure certificate has been issued and message you if it has not.
support_next_steps.timeline: tomorrow morning (the morning after the call)

omitted_item_ids.reason: diagnostic check with no outcome useful to the customer
